jobs.description:
Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
 

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

Plouvier Group is looking for a Safety Advisor to join our team.
 

With 
20 vessels and 165 colleagues, Plouvier operates a modern inland tanker fleet across Europe. We are looking for an experienced QHES professional with a strong background in 
ADN, dangerous goods and inland tanker operations.
 

As 
ADN Safety Advisor, you will play an important role in maintaining regulatory compliance and continuously improving QHES standards across our fleet.
 

Your role
 

You will be responsible for ensuring that our vessels, procedures and documentation remain compliant with 
ADN and applicable inland shipping regulations.
 

Your key responsibilities include:
 
 

• Ensuring 
ADN compliance across the fleet. 

• Acting as 
ADN Safety Advisor and providing practical guidance to vessel crews. 

• Monitoring regulatory developments and translating them into clear procedures. 

• Conducting and reviewing 
risk assessments, work permits and safety procedures. 

• Supporting incident and near-miss investigations and corrective actions. 

• Maintaining accurate and traceable 
QHES and ADN documentation. 

• Working with Captains, crew and Superintendents through 
focus groups to identify risks and improve procedures. 

• Supporting 
SIRE/VIQ, BIQ, TMSA, OCIMF and ADN audits and inspections.  

 

Your profile
 

We are looking for someone who combines strong 
ADN knowledge with practical experience in the maritime or inland shipping sector.
 

You have:
 
 

• A valid 
ADN Safety Advisor certificate. 

• Practical experience with 
ADN and dangerous goods. 

• Experience in 
inland tanker shipping is highly valued. 

• Knowledge of QHES, HSE and 
Safety Management Systems (SMS). 

• Experience with risk assessments, incident investigations and audits. 

• Excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills. 

• The ability to turn regulations into practical solutions for vessel crews. 

• Fluent English, German and Dutch 

• A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience. 

• Experience with SIRE/VIQ, TMSA or OCIMF is an advantage.

• Cleaning up the fields, removing leftover materials and carrying out minor maintenance tasks

• All other practical tasks needed to keep the horticultural production running smoothly

• You are physically fit and have no problem bending, lifting or working in different weather conditions

• You are reliable, punctual and motivated

• You enjoy working hard in a dynamic environment

• You can communicate in Dutch, French or English

• You are flexible and potentially available to work weekends

Working hours:

Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM

Occasional Saturdays, depending on workload or weather conditions

All overtime hours are paid

• Fluent in English; Dutch is a plus

jobs.occupation: Multilingual Customer Advisor – DE/EN/(NL or FR) in Liège
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about delivering outstanding customer service and fluent in multiple languages? As a Customer Advisor in our Liège-based team, you’ll be the first point of contact for customers, ensuring their needs are met with professionalism and efficiency. You’ll interact with international clients through various channels – calls, emails, and chat – providing accurate, friendly, and timely support.

You will support Satellic customers through different communication channels and provide professional, efficient assistance regarding their requests and issues: handling calls, emails, and chats related to the road toll for freight vehicles in Belgium and, in the future, other projects such as Monizze, Arrive, Fain and verification of on-board documents via the CRM system.

Ready to take the next step in your career? If you have strong language skills, a commitment to delivering excellent service, and thrive in a fast-paced, multicultural environment, we want to hear from you. Apply today and become a valued member of our international customer service team in Liège!

• Excellent command of English, both spoken and written

• Successful completion of an English language assessment

• Strong communication and customer service skills

• Good computer literacy and ability to learn new systems

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, multicultural environment

• Fluency in one or more of the following language combinations: Dutch + English, German + English, German + English + French, or German + English + Dutch

• Trilingual candidates are highly valued

• Additional language skills may qualify for a language bonus

• Upper secondary education completed

• 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in customer service or a related field

• Availability for rotating shifts between 07:00 and 22:00 (potential for homeworking)

• Full-time availability

For a logistics company in Lokeren, we are looking for packing employees who can work in a day shift.

You are responsible for the correct handling and shipment of incoming goods.

You will follow a pick list to pack and sort the goods according to their destination.

As a Talent & Business Consultant, you will play a key role in connecting top technology professionals with leading businesses across Belgium.

Operating at the intersection of people and business, you will act as a trusted advisor to both clients and candidates while building your own network and market expertise.

 

Client Details

Our client is a leading international consultancy specialized in Technology and Digital Transformation recruitment. They partner with innovative startups, scale-ups, and global organizations to help them attract the talent shaping tomorrow's digital world.

Driven by entrepreneurship, excellence, and collaboration, they empower their consultants to build strong market expertise, develop meaningful business relationships, and make a lasting impact on companies and professionals alike.

 

Description

Develop your client portfolio

• Build and maintain relationships with technology leaders and hiring managers.
• Identify new business opportunities and expand existing partnerships.
• Understand clients' growth plans, challenges, and recruitment needs.
• Advise clients on talent market trends and hiring strategies.

Connect with top talent

• Identify, attract, and engage highly skilled professionals.
• Conduct in-depth interviews to understand candidates' ambitions and motivations.
• Guide candidates throughout the recruitment process.
• Support professionals in making important career decisions.

Drive successful recruitment projects

• Manage recruitment assignments from A to Z.
• Match talent with business needs.
• Negotiate offers and facilitate successful placements.
• Build long-term relationships with both clients and candidates.

 

You don't necessarily need recruitment experience to succeed.

We are looking for individuals who:

• Speak English with at least a native level in French OR Dutch.
• Are passionate about building relationships.
• Have a strong commercial mindset.
• Enjoy working towards ambitious goals.
• Are naturally curious and eager to learn about businesses and industries.
• Thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
• Possess excellent communication and influencing skills.
• Are resilient, proactive, and results-oriented.
Experience in sales, consulting, business development, customer success, hospitality, banking, or recruitment is considered a plus.

• Good knowledge of Excel and Word; experience in air freight/logistics is a plus.

• IATA certification is a plus.

• A positive mindset, problem-solving ability, and a good sense of humor.

jobs.occupation: English-speaking CE truck driver - frozen food transport
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced CE Driver who's living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home most evenings?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium
• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)
Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.
